question: 'Pandava' dance, performed during Dussehra and Diwali, belongs to which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandava Dance** is a traditional folk dance performed in the state of **Uttarakhand**, especially during **Dussehra** and **Diwali**.
 
• This dance form is inspired by the epic tale of the **Mahabharata**, particularly focusing on the stories of the **five Pandavas**.
 
• The dance is conducted to narrate mythological tales and is deeply rooted in the **Garhwali and Kumaoni culture** of Uttarakhand.
 
• The performers use traditional instruments such as **drums and cymbals** to enhance the storytelling, making it a lively and engaging experience.
 
• Pandava Dance is a significant part of the festive traditions and showcases the cultural richness of **Uttarakhand**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Other Cultural Dances of Uttarakhand:**

 
 
• **Choliya Dance:** A martial art-based dance performed by the **Kumaoni Rajputs**.
 
• **Barada Nati:** Famous in the Jaunsar-Bawar region, performed during **weddings** and celebrations.
 
• **Langvir Nritya:** A traditional acrobatic dance, predominantly performed by males.
 
 
 
• **Festivals in Uttarakhand:**
 
 
• **Kumaoni Holi:** Known for its musical gatherings and unique style of celebration.
 
• **Harela:** Celebrated to mark the beginning of the sowing season in July.
 
• **Diwali:** Apart from traditional celebrations, **Pandava Dance** forms a key part of the festivities.
 
 
 
• **Geography of Uttarakhand:**
 
 
• Located in the northern part of India, it is known for its **Himalayan landscapes**.
 
• The state comprises two regions: **Garhwal** and **Kumaon**.
 
• Uttarakhand is famous for its religious sites, including **Kedarnath, Badrinath, Haridwar, and Rishikesh**.
 
 
 
• **Historical Background:**
 
 
• Uttarakhand was carved out of **Uttar Pradesh** in the year **2000**.
 
• The state is known as the **Land of Gods** due to its many pilgrimage sites.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Pandava Dance and Epic Connection:**

 
 
• The dance represents the tales of **Mahabharata**, portraying the valor and struggles of the **Pandava brothers**.
 
• It serves as a medium to connect the present generation with the rich mythological and cultural heritage of India.
 
 
 
• **Significance in Uttarakhand's Culture:**
 
 
• Pandava Dance is not just a performance but also a form of **devotional practice**.
 
• It reflects the spiritual connection of the people with their **ancestors** and **mythological heroes**.
